title: nan
authors: Pizani Domiciano M.A.; Hideiti Shiguemori E.; Alberto Vieira Dias L.; Marques Da Cunha A.
key_contribution: Presents the use of Digital Elevation Model (DEM) data in autonomous air navigation based on image odometry in GNSS-denied environments.
